candidate.de: Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
The grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity.
